raw.title: IT Support Apprentice / Graduate Service Desk Analyst
raw.description:
**IT Support Apprentice / Graduate Service Desk Analyst**

**Start your career in IT with real hands\-on experience**

Are you an IT graduate looking for your first professional role, or someone interested in starting an IT apprenticeship?

GB Agencies Ltd is looking for an enthusiastic, technically curious and customer\-focused person to join our growing IT team. You do not need to arrive with years of commercial IT experience. We are looking for someone with the right attitude, a genuine interest in technology and the motivation to learn.

You will receive mentoring and practical experience across service desk support, Microsoft 365, networking, cybersecurity, cloud services, servers and IT infrastructure.

This is not a role where you will be limited to resetting passwords. You will begin by developing strong Level 1 support skills and, as your knowledge and confidence grow, receive exposure to Level 2 support, systems administration, infrastructure projects and cloud technologies.

**Who is this opportunity for?**

We welcome applications from:

* **IT apprentices** looking to begin a professional career while working towards a recognised apprenticeship qualification.
* **Recent IT graduates** who have completed an IT\-related degree within the last two years and want to turn their academic knowledge into practical experience.
* Candidates with strong personal, academic or voluntary IT experience who can demonstrate a genuine interest in technology and problem\-solving.

**Skills and experience you will gain**

You will develop practical Level 1 support skills before progressing into Level 2 technologies, including:

* **Service desk support**: Diagnose incidents, manage tickets, work to SLAs, communicate with users and produce technical documentation.
* **Windows and hardware**: Configure and support Windows 10/11 computers, applications, printers, peripherals and mobile devices.
* **Microsoft 365**: Gain experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID and Intune.
* **Active Directory**: Manage users, computers, groups, permissions, Group Policy and employee onboarding and offboarding.
* **Networking**: Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, network printers, Cisco networking and connectivity between sites.
* **Servers and virtualisation**: Gain exposure to Windows Server, Hyper\-V, file servers, patching, backups and infrastructure monitoring.
* **Cybersecurity**: Work with MFA, BitLocker, endpoint security, vulnerability management, access controls and security incidents.
* **Projects and automation**: Support infrastructure upgrades, system deployments and business projects, with exposure to PowerShell and process automation.

**What you will be doing**

Your initial responsibilities will include:

* Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshooting Windows, Microsoft 365, hardware, software and connectivity issues.
* Managing user accounts, passwords and access requests.
* Installing and configuring computers, applications, printers and other equipment.
* Preparing equipment and accounts for new employees.
* Keeping users informed and maintaining accurate technical records.
* Escalating complex incidents and learning from experienced team members.

As your knowledge and confidence grow, you will progress into Level 2 activities involving servers, Microsoft 365 administration, networking, endpoint management, cybersecurity, backups and infrastructure projects.

**What we are looking for**

You do not need to have experience in every technology listed above. Training, guidance and mentoring will be provided.

We are looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in IT, technology and problem\-solving.
* Has a basic understanding of Windows computers and Microsoft applications.
* Is willing to learn about Microsoft 365, networking, servers, cloud services and cybersecurity.
* Enjoys helping people and can explain technical information clearly.
* Takes ownership of tasks and follows them through to completion.
* Can manage priorities and remain organised.
* Pays close attention to detail.
* Works well independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Is curious, proactive and comfortable asking questions.
* Demonstrates professionalism and a positive attitude.

Personal projects, home labs, university projects, certifications, volunteering and previous customer\-service experience are all valuable and should be included in your application.

**Requirements**

* An interest in developing a long\-term career in IT.
* An IT\-related degree, relevant studies or eligibility to undertake an IT apprenticeship.
* A full UK or EU driving licence, as occasional travel to company sites may be required.
* The ability to commute to our Grimsby office.
* Existing legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Working hours**

* Full\-time, Monday to Friday.
* Primarily based at our Grimsby office.
* Occasional travel to other company locations.
* Participation in an out\-of\-hours support rota may be introduced once you have completed the necessary training and are ready to provide support independently.

**What we offer**

* A structured introduction to professional IT support.
* Hands\-on experience across Level 1 and Level 2 technologies.
* Mentoring and support from experienced IT professionals.
* Ongoing technical training and professional development.
* A recognised apprenticeship qualification for an apprentice candidate.
* Exposure to enterprise Microsoft, cloud, networking and security technologies.
* Opportunities to participate in infrastructure and business technology projects.
* A clear development path into Level 2 Support, Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, Cybersecurity or Cloud Engineering.
* Company pension.
* On\-site parking.
* A friendly and supportive IT team.

If you are excited about technology and want an opportunity to build genuine, practical IT experience, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Please note that we are unable to offer sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Benefits:

* Company pension
* On\-site parking

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Grimsby DN31 3UA: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* Do you have British citizenship or indefinite leave to remain in the UK?

Licence/Certification:

* Full UK or full EU Driving license? (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person

raw.description:
**Apprentice \- Tier I IT Support Analyst**

*Start your career in IT with hands\-on experience across IT support, cloud, cybersecurity, AI and automation.*

**Company Overview**

Offsite Cloud is an established IT Managed Service Provider (MSP) based in Essex, providing IT support and technology solutions to businesses across a range of industries.

We are looking for an enthusiastic Apprentice Tier I IT Support Analyst to join our Service Desk team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to start a career in IT and gain hands\-on experience while completing an IT apprenticeship. You will work alongside experienced IT professionals, developing practical skills across IT support, Microsoft cloud technologies, networking, cybersecurity, AI and automation.

**The Role**

As an Apprentice Tier I IT Support Analyst, you will provide first\-line IT support to our customers while developing the technical knowledge and experience required to become an effective IT Support Analyst.

You will initially work under the guidance of experienced team members, assisting with routine support requests and technical issues. As your knowledge and confidence develop, you will be given increasing responsibility and the opportunity to become more involved in technical support, monitoring and customer projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as a first point of contact for customer IT support enquiries.
* Log, update and manage support tickets through our Service Desk system.
* Troubleshoot and resolve routine Windows, Microsoft 365, software, hardware and connectivity issues, seeking guidance where required.
* Carry out routine Microsoft 365 and cloud administration tasks.
* Monitor customer systems and respond to alerts, escalating more complex issues where appropriate.
* Complete routine user account creation, configuration and other service requests.
* Identify and escalate technical issues that fall outside their level of competence or authority.
* Keep customers informed and maintain accurate ticket and technical documentation.
* Support customer projects and technology deployments, taking increasing ownership of assigned tasks as experience develops.
* Develop and apply practical knowledge of networking, servers, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, backup and virtualisation.
* Develop and apply practical use of AI and automation tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to support service delivery and productivity.
* Complete the training, coursework and assessments required as part of the apprenticeship.
* By the end of the apprenticeship, be capable of independently handling routine Tier I support tasks and service requests to the required standard.

**Requirements**

Previous professional IT experience is not required. We are looking for someone with the right attitude, a genuine interest in technology and a willingness to learn.

* A genuine interest in IT and technology.
* Basic knowledge of computers and Microsoft Windows.
* An interest in Computers, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, networking and AI.
* Good problem\-solving skills and a willingness to investigate problems.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* A professional and customer\-focused attitude.
* The ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* A willingness to learn, accept feedback and develop new skills.
* Good organisation and attention to detail.
* A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel to customer sites when required.
* GCSE Grade C/4 or above in English and Mathematics (or equivalent).The legal right to work in the United Kingdom.

**Please note:** Offsite Cloud is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom without requiring sponsorship.

**What You'll Learn**

This apprenticeship will provide hands\-on experience working with real customers and business IT environments. You will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience across:

* Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365
* Backup and disaster recovery
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Virtualisation
* Networking, DNS, DHCP and VPN technologies
* AI and automation technologies
* IT security and cybersecurity
* IT Service Desk and customer service
* Windows Server and Active Directory
* IT project delivery
* Hardware and software troubleshooting

You'll be supported by experienced members of our technical team throughout your apprenticeship, with increasing responsibility as your skills and confidence develop.

**What We Offer**

* £17,000 starting salary
* Structured IT apprenticeship and training
* Hands\-on experience across a wide range of technologies
* Support and mentoring from experienced IT professionals
* Opportunities for professional development and career progression
* Exposure to traditional IT infrastructure, modern cloud technologies, AI and automation
* 20 days' annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays.
* An additional day off for your birthday
* Supportive and collaborative working environment
* Digital Support Technician Level 3 Apprenticeship via Ginger Nut Training.

**Build your IT career with us**

For the right person, this apprenticeship provides an opportunity to build a broad technical foundation and progress into a permanent IT Support Analyst position. If you're enthusiastic about technology, enjoy solving problems and want to start building a career in IT, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: From £17,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Free parking

Education:

* GCSE or equivalent (required)

Language:

* English (required)

Work Location: In person

Dear Offsite Cloud team,

I am writing to apply for the Apprentice Tier I IT Support Analyst position. Having followed Offsite Cloud’s work as an Essex-based MSP, I am impressed by your commitment to providing robust technology solutions across diverse industries. I am eager to start my career in a hands-on environment where I can contribute to your service desk while developing my expertise in Microsoft 365, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity.

My technical background is built on practical, real-world application. In my recent project, I deployed and maintained a 24/7 production system on an Oracle Cloud VM. This required me to monitor system health, manage incident response, and implement automated error-handling logic to ensure continuous uptime. I also authored 121 automated tests using pytest, which allowed me to catch and resolve issues before they impacted the system—a proactive approach I am ready to bring to your ticket management and monitoring workflows.

Beyond my technical skills, I pride myself on my ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. For my NHS A&E performance analysis project, I used SQL to classify 188 months of operational data and built interactive Power BI dashboards to communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders. This experience in documentation and clear communication is directly transferable to the customer-facing nature of your Tier I support role.

I am fully committed to the Digital Support Technician Level 3 Apprenticeship and am ready to learn from your experienced technical team. I hold a full UK driving licence and am prepared to travel to customer sites as required. I would appreciate the chance to discuss how my technical foundation and customer-first mindset can support the Offsite Cloud team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sohan Kusuma

raw.description:
**Service Desk Analyst (1st \& 2nd Line IT Support)**


We welcome applications for this support post to commence as soon as possible


**For an outstanding candidate the college will consider a 'golden hello' payment of up to 10% of the annual salary.**


**The Role**

The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:


The Service Desk Analyst provides professional, responsive and customer\-focused first and second\-line technical support across Cardinal Newman College and Lancaster University School of Mathematics. Working within the Service Desk \& End\-User Support team, the postholder delivers support both through the IT Service Desk and in person across classrooms, offices and shared learning spaces.


This is a hands\-on technical role. The postholder takes ownership of incidents and service requests from initial contact through diagnosis to resolution, investigating and resolving issues wherever possible rather than passing them on. Support is provided remotely where practical and in person where the fault is physical, urgent, or the teaching space is in use.


The role covers end\-user devices, classroom and audio\-visual technology, printing, user accounts and access, productivity and collaboration applications, connectivity and peripherals. Where an issue requires specialist infrastructure knowledge, elevated technical intervention, or relates to a wider\-impact service issue, the postholder escalates it through the agreed IT Service Management process with appropriate ownership, handover and communication.


For the full job description please see attached ‘Job Pack’.


**The Successful Candidate**


Cardinal Newman College is a wonderful place to work, and this is an exciting opportunity for a customer focussed and enthusiastic candidate to join our friendly and well established team.


The IT Services department is looking for someone who is technically capable, customer\-focused and a methodical problem solver who communicates clearly, stays calm under pressure and sees work through to resolution. Experience supporting end\-user technology is essential; knowledge of Microsoft technologies, endpoint management, IT Service Management, classroom technology or education is advantageous. Reliability, organisation, initiative, teamwork and a commitment to learning are equally important.


You should display the values, attitudes, and behaviours consistent with the Catholic Ethos of the College and have a commitment to equality and diversity and the safeguarding of young people and vulnerable adults.


**Terms and Conditions**


Hours: 37 hours per week, full year. Starting and finishing times will be on a rota basis between the hours of 8\.00am and 16\.45pm Monday to Friday.


Salary: The post will be paid on the Sixth Form Colleges’ Support Staff Pay Spine at points 14 to 15 \- £31,324 to £32,199 per annum. For an outstanding candidate the college will consider a 'golden hello' payment of up to 10% of the annual salary.


**Closing date for receipt of applications: 11\.59pm on Wednesday 23rd September 2026** (we reserve the right to close the advert in advance of this date).


**Why work at Cardinal Newman College?**


We are a happy and thriving Catholic Sixth Form College committed to equality and diversity, welcoming colleagues from all backgrounds into our community irrespective of their religion or belief, ethnicity, age, gender, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, marital or pregnancy status.


We are an outstanding college in every aspect and one of the highest\-performing Sixth Form Colleges nationally for Value Added. We recognise the invaluable contribution our dedicated staff make to the success of our students and the College as a whole. As such, we aim to foster a culture where staff feel valued and supported.


We also offer a range of excellent staff benefits, including:


* Generous Pension schemes for both teachers and support staff
* Pro rata to 25 days holidays plus 4 concessionary days and bank holidays for support staff
* Staff are contractually entitled to time off at Christmas in line with the college holidays, usually around 2 weeks.
* A genuine commitment to staff health and wellbeing
* Access to a salary sacrifice electric vehicle scheme
* Access to the Cycle to Work Scheme and Techscheme
* Free use of the on\-site gym
* Access to professional development and the opportunity to undertake professional qualifications through apprenticeships
* Flu Vouchers
* Staff savings scheme


More detailed information on further staff benefits can be found within our staff perks document attached.


**Completed application forms should be submitted by 11\.59pm on Wednesday 23rd September 2026\.**


We will confirm receipt of all applications by email within one working day of receipt. Please call the HR team if you have not received a confirmation email by the closing date. We do ask that you accept, in the interests of economy, that if you have not heard from us by mid October that you have not been selected for interview on this occasion.


**Further Information**


Further details are available at http://www.cardinalnewman.ac.uk/ or by telephone to the college on 01772 460181 or 07730 521 540\.


All offers of appointment are subject to Disclosure and Barring Service clearance as well as a range of other safer recruitment checks.

The post holder will need to operate within a busy call centre environment and will need to ensure that they follow procedures that have been developed. The service desk will have responsibility for logging all calls, owning all calls until closure, progress chasing and performing user account management. Delivered through over 100 settings from inpatient wards to out in the community, our 6,500 staff serve over 1 million people living in Leicester, Leicestershire and Rutland. We aim to develop a workforce that reflects our community. We actively implement equal opportunities in employment and service delivery and seek people who share our commitment. We strongly encourage applications from all sections of the community, particularly from underrepresented groups. Details of our benefits, leadership behaviours and other important information can be found in the Information for Applicants, please view the supporting documents. We will consider requests to work alternative hours or varied working patterns in line with our flexible working policy. For all substantive roles, new staff (excluding medical staff) are appointed subject to a 6\-month probationary period (see Probation Policy). All jobs will require permission to work in the UK. This role will have the responsibility for receiving all incoming issues and information requests to HIS with the brief to either resolve to a conclusion, or to pass or escalate to the appropriate person. All calls are to be logged whilst doing so. They will be responsible for communicating complicated IM\&T issues to non IM\&T staff/suppliers.


The post holder will need to operate within a busy call centre environment and will need to ensure that they follow procedures that have been developed.


The service desk will have responsibility for logging all calls, owning all calls until closure, progress chasing and performing user account management. This post may require flexible working hours, based upon the service requirements of the HIS client base.

* Act as first point of contact for HIS Service endusers on the customer service desk.
* Answer, log and manage all calls, emails and faxes to the Service Desk.
* Work within SLA/OLA requirements, ensuring issues are owned and progressed to resolution.
* Maintain and contribute to the HIS knowledge base.
* Analyse and resolve complex IM\&T queries, including software and hardware configuration.
* Support clients with account management, GP connections, desktop issues, mobile phones and application software across Trust sites and other organisations per SLA.
* Process user account and VPN forms following set procedures.
* Ensure issues are resolved within SLA or escalated to secondline support.
* Maintain IT systems and user accounts, ensuring accurate access and contributing to IM\&T improvements.
* Follow up resolutions to ensure user satisfaction.
* Liaise with internal teams, thirdparty engineers and suppliers to ensure timely responses.
* Assist in managing the Service Desk application, including user accounts, categories and call allocation.
* Meet quality and performance targets set by Service Delivery Management.
* Escalate incidents to external support agencies when required.
* Promote and comply with the organisation’s equal opportunities policy.

**This job description is not exhaustive and may be reviewed and amended in consultation with the post holder.**

**We may close the advert early, if we receive a sufficient number of applicants, so please apply as soon as possible.**


About Us


Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust (LPT) provides a range of community health, mental health and learning disability services for people of all ages. Delivered through over 100 settings from inpatient wards to out in the community, our 6,500 staff serve over 1 million people living in Leicester, Leicestershire and Rutland.


We aim to develop a workforce that reflects our community. We actively implement equal opportunities in employment and service delivery and seek people who share our commitment. We strongly encourage applications from all sections of the community, particularly from underrepresented groups.


Details of our benefits, leadership behaviours and other important information can be found in the Information for Applicants, please view the supporting documents.


We will consider requests to work alternative hours or varied working patterns in line with our flexible working policy.


For all substantive roles, new staff (excluding medical staff) are appointed subject to a 6\-month probationary period (see Probation Policy).


All jobs will require permission to work in the UK.


For all jobs the cost of any DBS disclosure required will be met by the individual. This will be deducted from salary once started.

**Where ambitious people connect the dots and grow** 




 At Confirm, we’re building what’s next in workforce enablement. We connect the dots between learning, engagement and performance, using intelligent technology, content and data to help organisations unlock the potential of their people.
 



 We’re a growing, global team where people are trusted to make an impact, take ownership and grow. Our values are at the heart of how we work: Do the right thing, We’ve got your back and Raise the bar. We care about doing work that matters, challenging ourselves to do it better and creating an environment where people can do their best work.
 



 Confirm is a B Corp certified business and a Platinum Investors in People organisation. We’re also proud of the recognition our work has received across the industry, including multiple Gold wins at the Learning Technologies Awards.
 



 If you’re looking for your next challenge, want the space to make your mark and like the idea of building something ambitious with good people around you, you’ve come to the right place.
 



  





**About the role:** 




  





 The successful candidate will be responsible for managing tier 2 support cases and troubleshooting complex issues across all of Confirms products and solutions within the application support team. You will triage and resolve these issues by deep diving into our applications and platform backend while working closely with our Development, Cloud Infrastructure and Support teams.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 




 Roles and responsibilities include:
 



  




* Provide multi\-level troubleshooting and technical support to clients to resolve product and hosting issues with speed and accuracy.
* Responsible for fault reproduction and troubleshooting, root cause analysis, bug tracking and issue resolution.
* Work closely with Customer Support, Development, and Infrastructure to improve the resolution time and quality of our responses.
* Deliver a positive experience by proactively tracking all tier 2 cases through the case lifecycle and ensuring clear communication between all stakeholders.
* Share and improve knowledge across all support tiers by creating technical documentation and giving internal demos.
* Support the automation first and continuous improvement strategy of the team and related duties as required.



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




 The successful candidate will demonstrate:
 



  




* Case management experience: You will have experience of effectively managing issues via a ticketing/case management system (such as JIRA or similar) to ensure regular communications between teams and that agreed resolution times are achieved.
* Technical competency: You will be able to demonstrate familiarity with web\-related technologies, such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, CDN, DNS.
* Service Orientation: You will be focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience.
* Critical thinking: You will have excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Communications: You have the ability to communicate to a high standard using multiple mediums (oral, written and interpersonal communication) with a knack for communicating technical information in a way that is clear and understandable to a non\-technical audience.
* Organisational: You will have strong organisational and time management skills.
* Adaptability: You will an interest in technology and the ability to learn and master new technology quickly
* Building relationships: You will have the ability to work in a collaborative and supportive environment across the wider team.



  





 Although not essential, it would be advantageous if you can demonstrate in the following:
 



  




* Experience with Confluence, JIRA, and Git
* Experience writing SQL and NOSQL queries
* Proficient with multiple computer operating systems – UNIX/Linux and Windows
* A third level qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field



  





 Closing date for receipt of applications is 5pm UK time on 18th September 2026\.

 When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data\-driven insights to build a healthier future.
   

  

**IT Support Analyst**
 We are looking for a customer\-focused IT Support Analyst to provide hands\-on 1st and 2nd line support within a client\-side IT environment. This office\-based role offers the opportunity to work across Microsoft 365, cloud technologies, networking and on\-premise systems, with excellent training and career progression opportunities.
   

  

**About the Role:**
* Location: Prescot. Office based role.
* Shift/Hours: Monday to Friday, 37\.5 hours per week
* Contract: Full Time \& Permanent
* Closing Date: Tuesday 15th September 2026


**The Day to Day**
* Provide 1st and 2nd line technical support to users on\-site and remotely.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, email and connectivity issues.
* Support Microsoft 365, Office 365, Exchange, Outlook, Windows and on\-premise systems.
* Manage incidents and service requests through the helpdesk system, escalating complex issues where required.
* Install, configure and maintain computers, laptops, printers, peripherals and other IT equipment.
* Manage user accounts, permissions and access in line with company policies and security requirements.
* Maintain accurate support records and keep users informed throughout the resolution process.
* Support IT projects, upgrades, deployments and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Deliver a professional, customer\-focused service while managing competing priorities effectively.


**The Essentials**
* Proven experience in a 1st or 2nd Line IT Support, Service Desk or Helpdesk role.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving and customer\-service skills.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Exchange, Outlook and Windows environments.
* Good understanding of hardware, on\-premise systems and networking principles, including TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP.
* Experience using ticketing or service desk systems.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical users.
* Able to work independently, prioritise workloads and contribute effectively within a team.
* Proactive, organised, methodical and keen to develop a career in IT support.
* Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, Azure/Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, VPNs or endpoint security would be advantageous.
* Relevant qualifications such as CompTIA, Microsoft certifications or ITIL would be desirable.


**Our Benefits Include:**
* Attractive Salary
* Private Healthcare
* Discretionary annual bonus
* Life Assurance
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
* 6% employer pension
* Free parking
* Fully subsidised staff canteen


**Working at ALS**
 The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.
   

  

 Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.
   

  

 At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.
   

  

 We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
   

  

**Everyone Matters**
 ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
   

  

 ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.
   

  

**Eligibility**
 To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please apply on\-line and provide a resume \& cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

raw.title: Pathology Service Desk Assistant
raw.description:
An exciting secondment opportunity has arisen for an IT technician role within the Pathology IT Team.
  
  

We are seeking to appoint an enthusiastic individual to work within the Pathology IT team at Gateshead.
  
  

The post holder will work as part of the Pathology IT Team on a day to day basis to provide end\-user support for pathology systems.
  
  

Able to use initiative and work to tight deadlines.
  
  

The successful candidate will s erve as an IT technician for pathology systems and will act as the first point of contact for system users, resolving issues or escalation to technical teams or suppliers when required.
  
  

A flexible approach to working arrangements is essential to meet service needs, which may include working evenings, early mornings or weekends.
  
  

Based in the North East of England we provide a range of hospital and community health services from our leading facilities, including the Queen Elizabeth Hospital, Blaydon urgent care centre and Bensham Hospital, all within Gateshead.
  
  

Established in 2005, we were one of the first foundation trusts in the country and since then have consistently achieved the highest levels of care for patients.
  
  

We now employ around 4,800 staff and currently provide 444 hospital beds across the Gateshead region.
  
  

Our values should be the ‘golden thread’ which runs through everything we do – they are the core of who we are. Our five values can easily be remembered by the simple acronym ICORE; Innovation, Care, Openness, Respect, Engagement.
  
  

We have a number of staff networks including the BAME network, D\-Ability network, LGBTQ\+ Network and the Women’s Network, to challenge us and help us to constantly improve. Our armed forces network is one of our emerging networks.
  
  

The health and wellbeing of our staff is one of our highest priorities, and we offer a range of support and initiatives as part of our ‘Balance’ programme balancegateshead.com to cater for our diverse workforce, so that your individual needs can be supported, allowing you a happy and healthy working experience with us.
  
  

Prime Responsibilities
  
  

Communications \& Relationship skills
  
  

Manning of the Pathology IT Service Desk, acting as the first point of contact for all customers both within GHNT and supported third party organisations
  
Ensuring that all calls are answered within the Trust “First Class Hospitals” standard of under 18 seconds
  
Provide first level end user support to Trust and supported third party organisations where possible and appropriate, otherwise forwarding calls to the most appropriate person or organisation for second/third level support, including use of remote support tools as appropriate
  
Ability to actively listen to users of the services and extract relevant information to determine their requirements or the root cause of any issues.
  
Ability to show empathy for service users experiencing issues and demonstrate an understanding of the business impact caused.
  
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with a wide range of end users and support staff from multiple backgrounds and organisations, including “difficult” users, on potentially complex or sensitive information
  
Provide a customer focused approach to ensure we deliver a responsive and effective service to users.
  
Work with other support staff in the local Gateshead health community in the implementation of Service Desk facilities to support healthcare delivery.
  
Liaison with support representatives of other organisations to ensure that problems are directed to the most appropriate support staff for resolution
  
Working with local and national service providers to ensure that Service Desk call forwarding (seamless ticketing) is implemented between Trust Service Desk software and provider helpdesk systems
  
Work collaboratively with all members of the digital teams to deliver a seamless, efficient and effective service.
  
Provision of support for the laboratory information system and all associated applications
  
Ability to communicate through written, electronic and verbal media at a wide range of levels, including the ability to present highly technical and/or complex concepts in readily understandable language
  
Working with Trust IT department to ensure that orders are processed appropriately, and with support staff to manage installation workloads
  
  

* Knowledge, Training \& Experience


Educated to NVQ Level III or with equivalent experience, preferably educated to degree level or equivalent in depth experience in an IT related subject, relevant technical certifications or qualifications
  
Substantial experience of end user first level support experience
  
Strong customer service skills gained in dealing with a broad range of users of a service, not necessarily within IT
  
Knowledge of and experience in using Service Desk software, including call transfer to other organisation helpdesk systems
  
Technical knowledge of IT hardware, operating systems and end\-user productivity tools
  
Maintain up to date knowledge of technical hardware and software used within Pathology and supported third party organisations, including but not limited to Meditech LIMS, ICE Desktop, analyser data managers
  
Familiarity with on\-line technical and support resources
  
Experience in using and maintaining databases
  
Willingness to enhance own skill set in relation to developments in desktop technology and software environments
  
Demonstrated recent development of knowledge and skills in support of the Service Desk role
  
Knowledge of national coding structure including but not limited to Read Codes, SNOMED, SNOMED\-CT and the Universal Test Library (UTL)
  
Possess, or working towards ITIL Green Badge certification
  
Possess, or working towards Service Desk Institute Service Desk Analyst qualifications
  
Maintain personal and professional development to meet the changing demands of the job and participate in appropriate training activities
  
Flexible, dedicated and with the appropriate combination of practical and theoretical approaches
  
Knowledge of and exposure to National developments of NHS digital projects and programmes
  
Relevant NHS experience is desirable
  
  

* Planning \& Organisational Skills


Manage the enrolment and maintenance of user accounts for ICE Desktop, Meditech and data managers, ensuring that starters, leavers and movers are correctly processed
  
Management of the Service Desk call log in association with the second level support teams to ensure that all calls are accurately logged, and that users are appraised of call status where appropriate
  
Management of hardware and software fault call logs for tracking third party support calls
  
Tracking and management of all quotes, requisitions and invoices for IT related hardware and software, liaising with the Pathology IM\&T Manager to ensure that appropriate technical and other standards are enforced
  
  

* Responsibility for Policy \& Service Development


Responsible for following and implementing policies relating to working within the IT function
  
Management of documentation, procedures and, in association with the Pathology IM\&T Manager, policies relating to the operation of the pathology systems applicable to Trust and supported third party organisations
  
Assist with development and assessment of new operational policies and guidelines within the IT function
  
Responsible for proposing changed or updated policies relating to working within the IT function
  
Work with the Pathology IM\&T Manager on the implementation of pathology related solutions for the Trust
  
  

* Responsibility for Financial \& Physical Resources


Responsible for the safe and secure receipt, handling and storage of expensive equipment
  
Responsible for purchase of IT related assets
  
Tracking and management of all orders, requisitions and invoices for IT related hardware and software, liaising with the Pathology IM\&T Manager to ensure that appropriate technical and other standards are enforced
  
  

* Responsibility for Human Resources


Train Trust and other organisation staff in the use of the Service Desk system
  
Supervise more junior members of staff
  
Responsible for training of end users on ICE label printing devices
  
  

* Responsibility for Information Resources


Management and development of the Pathology IT hardware and software asset log on QPulse to ensure that all relevant Trust and supported third party organisation assets are accurately recorded and tracked
  
Use the Laboratory Information System according to the authorised procedures and policies
  
Enter and retrieve Patient data using the Laboratory Information System
  
Comply with local and national policies for the safe, secure and confidential processing, and storage of patient and other laboratory data
  
Daily management of the electronic results messaging solutions to ensure results are distributed to primary care requestors in a timely manner and any identified issues are resolved without significant delay
  
Production of performance statistics to assist the Pathology IT in management and improvement of the support function, including the production of the necessary reports for managing third party service level agreements

jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.company: Leeds and York Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
jobs.description: The ICT Service Desk function serves as the support gateway for all information, communication and technology and ICT training for approximately 4000 staff across Trust sites located across Leeds and York boundaries and supporting our wider regional wide services. The ICT Service Desk covers all IT and communication services ranging through software, hardware, network, servers, voice and data. To work within a team and provide first line ICT support services within the Trust using ITIL processes of Incident Management, Service Requests and an understanding of Problem and Change Management. Day to day working with a computerised telephone call handling system to efficiently handle incoming calls to the Service Desk. To ensure that the support provided to customers is consistent, timely, of high quality, follows all agreed processes and guidelines and to ensure policies and procedures are followed at all times. Provide technical support to users, troubleshoot IT issues, manage service requests, and ensure timely resolution. The Leeds and York Partnership NHS Foundation Trust (LYPFT) is the main provider of Mental Health and Learning Disability services in Leeds. We also provide specialist inpatient services in York and some highly specialised services across the country. As a teaching trust with strong links to local universities, we are a centre of excellence for teaching, research and development. There are many benefits of working for LYPFT including fantastic employee wellbeing support, 27 \- 33 days annual leave, flexible working and remote working arrangements, the NHS Pension Scheme, coaching, support and opportunities for career development and training and education support alongside a range of exclusive discounts and payment schemes including for cars, extra leave days and more NHS Discount Offers. We also have a bank department, offering variety of roles in nursing, allied health professions, healthcare support worker and administration clerical. Permanent employees are automatically added to bank. Applicants should be aware that individuals requiring a visa to work in the UK, the Trust only provides sponsorship for registered healthcare practitioner roles (this does not include Healthcare Support Workers) . This is an essential requirement, and the Trust is unable to offer you a role if you do not meet Trust requirements for sponsorship and Home Office requirements for a visa. We recruit people based on their values and qualifications (where required) and believe that their lived experience is an advantage, this means that together we are as diverse as the communities we care for. Simply put, when we employ caring people who act with integrity and have the right skills, we can give those with mental health challenges, learning disabilities and neurodiversity high\-quality care and support to live fulfilling lives, and make our staff feel purposeful, happy and valued. raw.company: Leeds and York Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
raw.description:
The ICT Service Desk function serves as the support gateway for all information, communication and technology and ICT training for approximately 4000 staff across Trust sites located across Leeds and York boundaries and supporting our wider regional wide services. The ICT Service Desk covers all IT and communication services ranging through software, hardware, network, servers, voice and data.
  
To work within a team and provide first line ICT support services within the Trust using ITIL processes of Incident Management, Service Requests and an understanding of Problem and Change Management. Day to day working with a computerised telephone call handling system to efficiently handle incoming calls to the Service Desk.
  
To ensure that the support provided to customers is consistent, timely, of high quality, follows all agreed processes and guidelines and to ensure policies and procedures are followed at all times.
  
  

Provide technical support to users, troubleshoot IT issues, manage service requests, and ensure timely resolution.
  
  

The Leeds and York Partnership NHS Foundation Trust (LYPFT) is the main provider of Mental Health and Learning Disability services in Leeds. We also provide specialist inpatient services in York and some highly specialised services across the country. As a teaching trust with strong links to local universities, we are a centre of excellence for teaching, research and development.
  
  

There are many benefits of working for LYPFT including fantastic employee wellbeing support, 27 \- 33 days annual leave, flexible working and remote working arrangements, the NHS Pension Scheme, coaching, support and opportunities for career development and training and education support alongside a range of exclusive discounts and payment schemes including for cars, extra leave days and more NHS Discount Offers.
  
  

We also have a bank department, offering variety of roles in nursing, allied health professions, healthcare support worker and administration clerical. Permanent employees are automatically added to bank.
  
  

Applicants should be aware that individuals requiring a visa to work in the UK, the Trust only provides sponsorship for registered healthcare practitioner roles (this does not include Healthcare Support Workers) . This is an essential requirement, and the Trust is unable to offer you a role if you do not meet Trust requirements for sponsorship and Home Office requirements for a visa.
  
  

We recruit people based on their values and qualifications (where required) and believe that their lived experience is an advantage, this means that together we are as diverse as the communities we care for. Simply put, when we employ caring people who act with integrity and have the right skills, we can give those with mental health challenges, learning disabilities and neurodiversity high\-quality care and support to live fulfilling lives, and make our staff feel purposeful, happy and valued.
  
All our information is available in accessible formats. Please contact the Recruitment team recruitment.lypft@nhs.net

raw.title: Technical Support Engineer – Automotive Software & ECU Systems
raw.description:
**Technical Support Engineer – Automotive Software \& ECU Systems**

**Salary:** £28,000–£34,000 per year, depending on relevant experience  
**Location:** Bidford\-on\-Avon, Warwickshire, B50 4JN  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Working Pattern:** Primarily office based

About VIEZU

VIEZU Technologies Ltd is an established automotive software and vehicle tuning company supporting dealers, tuning businesses and partners around the world.

Our technical team works with specialist vehicle software, ECU programming tools, diagnostic systems and calibration data across a wide range of vehicle manufacturers and platforms.

Due to continued growth, we are looking for an experienced and capable **Technical Support Engineer** to join the team.

This is not a general IT helpdesk position. We are looking for someone who already has strong technical support and problem\-solving skills and who wants to apply and develop those skills within a specialist automotive environment.

For the right person, the role also provides a structured pathway into **ECU calibration and vehicle tuning file development**.

The Role

Your initial focus will be providing high\-quality technical support to VIEZU dealers and customers using our software, vehicle programming tools and associated systems.

You will take ownership of technical problems, gather the right information, diagnose issues methodically and work with customers and colleagues to reach an appropriate resolution.

We are looking for someone who can work effectively within established systems and processes, but who also thinks for themselves. You should be capable of recognising recurring problems, identifying where a process, system or customer journey could be improved and contributing constructively to those improvements.

As your knowledge of our systems, vehicles and ECU technology develops, you will receive structured training in ECU calibration and tuning file development.

The objective is to develop the successful candidate into a **multi\-skilled automotive technical specialist**, capable of combining advanced technical support with ECU file development and calibration work.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide technical support to VIEZU dealers, customers and partners by telephone, email and support ticket.
* Diagnose software, hardware, communication and vehicle\-related problems using a structured and methodical approach.
* Take ownership of technical cases from initial report through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Ask effective diagnostic questions and obtain the information required to accurately understand a problem.
* Interpret error messages, logs, screenshots, system behaviour and customer information.
* Accurately record support activity and technical findings within CRM and ticketing systems.
* Support customers with VIEZU software, ECU programming tools, vehicle communication and associated technical systems.
* Assist with dealer onboarding, software setup and technical guidance.
* Escalate complex problems with clear, useful and technically relevant information.
* Identify recurring support issues and contribute to improvements in processes, documentation, training and customer guidance.
* Work with other members of the technical and development teams to resolve product and system issues.
* Progress through VIEZU's internal automotive and ECU training programme.
* Develop the skills required to undertake ECU tuning file preparation and calibration work as agreed training milestones are achieved.

What We Are Looking For

We are primarily interested in people who already know how to provide good technical support.

You may currently work in IT, software, telecommunications, telematics, automotive technology, industrial systems, electronics, technical product support or another specialist technical environment.

You do **not** need previous ECU tuning or file\-writing experience. We can provide that specialist training.

However, you should already be comfortable diagnosing technical problems, dealing directly with customers and taking responsibility for finding solutions.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Previous experience in a technical support, product support, application support, systems support or similar technical role.
* Strong computer literacy and confidence learning unfamiliar specialist software and systems.
* A logical and analytical approach to fault finding and problem\-solving.
* Experience investigating technical problems rather than relying solely on scripted responses.
* Confident and professional telephone manner.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical information clearly to customers with different levels of knowledge.
* Ability to manage technical support cases accurately from initial contact through to resolution.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise multiple tasks and work effectively under time pressure.
* Comfortable following established processes and procedures.
* Able to think independently when a problem falls outside those procedures.
* Willingness to identify recurring issues and suggest practical improvements.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technical subjects and systems.
* Genuine interest in developing specialist knowledge of automotive software, ECU systems and vehicle calibration.

Desirable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be advantageous, but is not essential:

* Second\-line or advanced technical support.
* Application or software support.
* SaaS technical support.
* Automotive diagnostics.
* Vehicle telematics or tracking systems.
* Dealer or aftermarket automotive systems.
* Vehicle programming or diagnostic tools.
* Electronics.
* Industrial automation.
* Manufacturing software or equipment support.
* Technical hardware support.
* Motorsport or vehicle performance.
* ECU tuning or calibration.

The Type of Person We Are Looking For

People who tend to succeed in this type of role are naturally curious about how systems work.

You should enjoy investigating problems, asking the right questions, spotting patterns and working out the underlying cause of an issue rather than simply applying the quickest available workaround.

You will need to be comfortable working within established procedures, while also having the confidence and judgement to raise concerns or suggest improvements when something could be done better.

We value people who take ownership of problems, communicate clearly and contribute ideas rather than simply completing the task immediately in front of them.

Career Fit

This role offers the opportunity to build specialist expertise in automotive software, ECU systems and vehicle calibration.

Previous vehicle tuning or ECU file\-writing experience is not required. We are looking for someone who already has a strong technical support background, enjoys investigating and resolving technical problems, and is motivated to develop deeper specialist knowledge within the automotive sector.

The role is particularly suited to someone looking for a long\-term technical career where they can combine customer support, problem\-solving and progressively more advanced ECU and calibration work.

As your knowledge and capability develop, you will receive structured training and mentoring with the aim of progressing into tuning file development and broader automotive technical responsibilities.

Career Development

Development within the role is based on demonstrated capability, technical understanding and completion of training milestones.

The expected development pathway includes:

**Technical Support**

Develop detailed knowledge of VIEZU systems, programming tools, customer workflows and vehicle communication.

**Advanced Automotive Technical Support**

Handle increasingly complex vehicle, ECU, software and programming\-related cases.

**ECU Calibration Training**

Develop an understanding of ECU architecture, calibration data and the principles involved in vehicle tuning.

**ECU File Development**

Begin preparing and modifying tuning files under supervision as competence and training milestones are achieved.

**Automotive Technical \& Calibration Specialist**

Develop into a multi\-skilled member of the technical team capable of supporting complex technical cases alongside ECU calibration and tuning file development.

Location and Working Arrangement

This role is primarily based at our offices in **Bidford\-on\-Avon, Warwickshire, B50 4JN**.

During the initial training period, expected to be approximately **4–6 months**, normal working hours are:

**Monday to Friday: 8:30am–5:30pm, with one hour for lunch.**

Due to the global nature of the VIEZU business, Technical Support operates across extended hours and seven days per week.

Following successful completion of training, the position will therefore require occasional evening and weekend support cover. This is scheduled in advance and shared fairly across the technical team.

Some out\-of\-hours support can be carried out remotely.

The resulting average working week is approximately **38–40 hours across five days**.

This role does **not** offer routine hybrid or remote working. Applicants should therefore live within a reasonable commuting distance of Bidford\-on\-Avon or be willing to relocate.

Eligibility

Applicants must:

* Have the right to work in the United Kingdom.
* Be able to work from our Bidford\-on\-Avon office as required.

**Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.**

What We Offer

* Salary of £28,000–£34,000 depending on relevant experience.
* Permanent, stable employment.
* Structured technical training and mentoring.
* Genuine development into ECU calibration and tuning file writing.
* Exposure to specialist automotive software, programming tools and vehicle technologies.
* Opportunity to develop highly specialised technical knowledge.
* An experienced technical team to work alongside and learn from.
* Private medical insurance.
* Company pension.
* Employee discount.
* Company events.
* Free on\-site parking.

Pay: £28,000\.00\-£34,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Company pension
* Free parking
* On\-site parking
* Private medical insurance

* United Kingdom (required)

raw.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end\-to\-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
   

  

**The Position**
 OPSWAT is now searching for a mid\-to\-senior level
 **Joint Professional Services and Technical Support Engineer to join our Global Customer Experience team and help our customers in the UK.** 
 In the Technical Support capacity, the engineer will coordinate with colleagues in the global Support team to respond to customers’ technical queries and issues, with the goal of resolving them quickly and satisfactorily, including escalating bugs to the R\&D team and managing the process to get the customer’s environment properly patched or upgraded. In the Professional Services capacity, the engineer will implement and integrate OPSWAT products and solutions purchased by customers, offer advice on best practices, provide knowledge transfer on administering the solution, and expose the customer to other OPSWAT solutions that might benefit them. The Joint Professional Services and Technical Support Engineer also works to mentor and lead others on the support team, to improve customer support processes, to maintain strong customer satisfaction, and to influence the product roadmap. As a member of a dynamic company, he or she also gets involved in other activities such as technical assistance to the Sales team, helping to test and assess new products and product releases, and other special projects.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Collaborating with the global OPSWAT Support team to resolve customer issues (which are often technical issues) rapidly and comprehensively, making sure to meet published SLAs.
* Working in a Technical Account Manager capacity to customers who are often very technically oriented (typical customers are engineers and IT personnel).
* Providing professional services for the implementation of OPSWAT products.
* Maintaining strong customer relationships through:
+ Regularly scheduled conference calls to review open issues.
+ Occasional in\-person meetings
+ Improving issue management processes within the company.
+ Coordinating activity between Support, R\&D, Product Management, and other departments.
+ Gaining expertise (both functional and limited technical) in OPSWAT products.
+ Going onsite and delivering professional services (training, system implementation) per request.
+ Getting engaged in other special project activities.

* Understanding customer IT requirements and goals
* Providing advice on the use of technology to implement OPSWAT products.


**What We Need From You**
* Bachelor's degree in a Computer Science, Technical discipline, or Equivalent experience.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Windows server.
* Basic knowledge of Linux, with an interest to expand that knowledge.
* Good foundation and willingness to expand knowledge of networking concepts.
* Basic knowledge of and willingness to expand knowledge of cybersecurity and critical infrastructure protection.
* Strong presentation skills (be able to describe things and convey ideas to others in an easy way).
* A proven customer\-oriented attitude, including the ability to work with difficult and/or frustrated customers.
* A passion for solving problems and making customers happy.
* Ability to think logically, analyze logs and troubleshoot computer software and IT related issues.
* Availability and willingness to travel as necessary to your assigned accounts, and to Company meetings.


**It Would Be Nice If You Had**
* Experience working with global teams.
* Cybersecurity domain experience, including file security, device security, network security and etc.
* Network integration skillsets (e.g. Cisco, Dell\-EMC, Juniper, Aruba, Ruckus, Meraki, Aerohive, Extreme, etc.).
* Hands\-on understanding of major DevOps tools: Docker, Kubernetes (GCP GKE), CI/CD tools, Terraform, Ansible, Monitoring \& Logging Tools (Zipkin, Sentry, Prometheus, ELK stack).
* Experience in Cloud Based Services (e.g. AWS, GCP).
* Experience working on Linux based infrastructure.
* Experience working with scripting languages such as bash script, PowerShell, and Python.
* Configuration and management of databases such as MySQL, Mongo.
* Experience in providing customer support of technical software products.


 This range reflects gross annual base salary only (depending on location and experience) and does not include equity or bonus.

Desk.

others.

jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek \- so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com. **Join Us in Cheadle (Manchester, UK):** You will join a successful team of Technical Support Engineers providing first class support to our customers utilising a variety of remote diagnostic tools. Your primary role will be troubleshooting and resolving software issues on customer’s Client/Server and Standalone PC configurations. This will require troubleshooting of PC network communication, instrument control, data analysis and database issues as well as using virtualization software to reproduce problems in\-house. You will also be required to provide support on out instrumentation so experience with analytical techniques are required. You will occasionally be required to visit customer sites for installations, repairs and scheduled services. The candidate must be very customer focussed, confident, flexible and willing to go the extra mile to delight our customers. **What You’ll Do:** * You will be providing a high level of reactive and proactive technical services in support of Agilent's product portfolio, primarily software products * You will be part a team of 15 remote technical engineers based in the head office in Cheadle * You will be responsible for remote trouble shooting on software, hardware and applications * You will be providing problem resolution in order to optimize the efficiency and uptime availability of customer systems. **About the Role** * 60% Office based/40% flexible location (Manchester) with requirements to travel abroad (training) and visit customers (installs, repairs, servicing) – approx. 15 – 20 % of the time **Qualifications** ------------------ **Your Profile:** * Bachelor, Master or PhD in Chemistry or Life Science based area with demonstratable IT/software skills * Experience with jobs.description: **Job Overview \-** Technical Support Engineer, Goudhurst, £35,000–£45,000\. GIBIDI UK Ltd is the sole UK distributor for GIBIDI Italy, supplying gate automation to trade installers across the country. We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer at our Goudhurst, Kent office. You're the person installers get through to when they're stood at a gate with a problem \- you diagnose the fault and talk them through the fix. Alongside that, you'd repair everything that comes back to us and run our hands\-on installer training days. It's off the tools but still in the trade: Monday to Friday, 8am–5pm, home every night. We'll teach you the product range in full. **Duties** * Answering the phone to installers, diagnosing the fault and talking them through the fix. This is most of the job. * Repairing everything that comes back to us: motors, control boards, all GIBIDI equipment. * Running the hands\-on installer training days. * Advising on the right kit for a gate \- weight, leaf length, duty cycle, 230V vs 24V, hydraulic vs electromechanical, safety compliance. * Identifying parts from a customer's description or a photo and turning them into a part number and an order. * Triaging warranty returns \- separating a genuine product fault from an install error before it becomes a credit note. * Writing up recurring faults so the same call doesn't come in twice. **Requirements** * Hands\-on gate, barrier or access control experience \- this is the one thing we can't teach quickly. * Able to read a wiring diagram and fault\-find by logic rather than guesswork. * Able to explain a fix to someone who can't see what you're seeing. * Patience on the phone when the caller is having a bad day. * Organised enough to write down what happened. * Experience in adjacent trades (CCTV, intruder alarm, door entry, industrial doors and barriers) considered \- most of the skill transfers, the product training is on us. **What you get** * £35,000–£45,000 a year, depending on experience * Full training with the sole UK distributor for GIBIDI Italy * A small team, where you're the technical voice of the business * Mon–Fri 8am–5pm * Based at our Goudhurst, Kent office Pay: £35,000\.00\-£45,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Company pension * Free parking * On\-site parking * Sick pay Work Location: In person

**Job Overview \-** Technical Support Engineer, Goudhurst, £35,000–£45,000\.

GIBIDI UK Ltd is the sole UK distributor for GIBIDI Italy, supplying gate automation to trade installers across the country. We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer at our Goudhurst, Kent office. You're the person installers get through to when they're stood at a gate with a problem \- you diagnose the fault and talk them through the fix. Alongside that, you'd repair everything that comes back to us and run our hands\-on installer training days. It's off the tools but still in the trade: Monday to Friday, 8am–5pm, home every night. We'll teach you the product range in full.

**Duties**

* Answering the phone to installers, diagnosing the fault and talking them through the fix. This is most of the job.
* Repairing everything that comes back to us: motors, control boards, all GIBIDI equipment.
* Running the hands\-on installer training days.
* Advising on the right kit for a gate \- weight, leaf length, duty cycle, 230V vs 24V, hydraulic vs electromechanical, safety compliance.
* Identifying parts from a customer's description or a photo and turning them into a part number and an order.
* Triaging warranty returns \- separating a genuine product fault from an install error before it becomes a credit note.
* Writing up recurring faults so the same call doesn't come in twice.

**Requirements**

* Hands\-on gate, barrier or access control experience \- this is the one thing we can't teach quickly.
* Able to read a wiring diagram and fault\-find by logic rather than guesswork.
* Able to explain a fix to someone who can't see what you're seeing.
* Patience on the phone when the caller is having a bad day.
* Organised enough to write down what happened.
* Experience in adjacent trades (CCTV, intruder alarm, door entry, industrial doors and barriers) considered \- most of the skill transfers, the product training is on us.

**What you get**

* £35,000–£45,000 a year, depending on experience
* Full training with the sole UK distributor for GIBIDI Italy
* A small team, where you're the technical voice of the business
* Mon–Fri 8am–5pm
* Based at our Goudhurst, Kent office

Pay: £35,000\.00\-£45,000\.00 per year

* Company pension
* Free parking

* Sick pay

**About Sustain**

Sustain is a rapidly growing renewable energy company specialising in solar PV, battery storage and other low\-carbon technologies. As our customer base continues to grow, we are looking for a **Solar Technical Support Engineer** to join our aftercare team and help us deliver a first\-class service to customers following their installation.

**The Role**

We are looking for someone with practical experience of **solar remote monitoring systems**, particularly **Fox ESS inverters and battery systems**, who is confident working through customer aftercare issues and coordinating solutions.

You will be responsible for managing a pipeline of aftercare support tickets, investigating issues remotely, working with manufacturers where required, and making sure customers are kept informed throughout the process.

Where an issue cannot be resolved remotely, you will coordinate an engineer revisit, ensuring the appointment is booked, tracked and completed, while maintaining clear communication with the customer.

The successful candidate will combine **solar industry knowledge, strong problem\-solving skills and excellent customer service**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and work through a pipeline of **solar and battery aftercare support tickets**.
* Use remote monitoring platforms to identify and investigate system issues.
* Have a strong working knowledge of **Fox ESS inverter and battery products**.

* Monitor inverter and battery performance and identify potential faults or issues.
* Liaise directly with **Fox ESS/manufacturer technical support teams** to troubleshoot and resolve faults.
* Clearly document investigations, actions and outcomes against customer tickets.
* Speak with customers to understand issues and explain solutions in a clear, reassuring and professional manner.
* Identify when an issue requires an engineer revisit and arrange the appropriate appointment.
* Track engineer revisits through to completion and ensure outstanding actions are followed up.
* Keep customers updated throughout the aftercare process, particularly where resolution may take time.
* Work closely with the installation, operations and customer service teams to resolve issues efficiently.
* Escalate recurring or serious technical issues to the appropriate internal team.
* Help identify trends in faults and aftercare issues so that we can continually improve our installation and customer experience.
* Ensure all customer records and ticket information are kept accurate and up to date.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential:**

* Previous experience within the **solar PV industry**.
* Experience using **remote monitoring platforms for solar PV and battery systems**.
* Specific experience with **Fox ESS inverters and batteries** is highly desirable and ideally essential.
* Understanding of common inverter, battery and monitoring issues.
* Experience carrying out or coordinating **firmware updates/upgrades**.
* Confident communicating with manufacturer technical support teams.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer cases simultaneously.
* Ability to investigate problems methodically and identify the appropriate next action.
* Comfortable using CRM, ticketing or job management systems.
* Strong attention to detail and accurate record keeping.

**Desirable:**

* Experience working with other inverter/battery manufacturers.
* Experience within a solar installation company's aftercare or technical support team.
* Familiarity with Fox ESS monitoring and commissioning processes.
* Experience coordinating engineer revisits or field service appointments.

**The Person**

You don't need to be an electrical engineer or someone who wants to spend their days on roofs or carrying out installations. Instead, you need to understand solar systems, be comfortable using remote monitoring tools and have the ability to work out what needs to happen next when something isn't working as expected.

You'll be dealing with customers who may be frustrated because their system isn't performing as expected, so being able to **take ownership of an issue, communicate clearly and see it through to resolution** is extremely important.

You'll also need to be comfortable picking up the phone, speaking to manufacturers and engineers, chasing outstanding actions and making sure nothing gets lost in the aftercare pipeline.

* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
